status: All seven visual directions and stronger-dimming variant approved for milestone planning; not implemented
reference: Current farm.png/config-storage.png; approved dashboard and Settings concepts from this conversation
prompt_direction: Restrained BambuStand TUI iteration; near-black surface, pale green thin cell-edge lines with small rounded corners, muted shared dividers and T-junctions, dark-green selected rows, slate footer, monospaced typography, bounded modals over dimmed dashboard. Preserve read-only semantics and existing keyboard controls. No printer controls, web cards, glow, or decorative illustrations.

screens.title: Dashboard
screens.intent: Shared panel boundaries, rounded corners, and a quiet hierarchy.
screens.review_question: Are the panel outlines helpful? Are the dotted detail separators too busy?

screens.title: Settings / General
screens.intent: Bounded Config over the farm, with tabs and its own active footer.
screens.review_question: Is the modal size comfortable? Should sparse sections use a shorter panel?

screens.title: Action needed
screens.intent: Reported outcome and next step lead; independent notices retain their metadata.
screens.review_question: Is the next step clear? Is the distinction between local review and physical intervention visible enough?

screens.title: AMS / Filament
screens.intent: Unit navigation, reported drying, slot table, and selected-slot details.
screens.review_question: Does the information grouping work? Is the table preferable to a more graphical spool view?

screens.title: Settings / Alerts
screens.intent: Existing preferences, immediate saves, and explicit notification-test acceptance.
screens.review_question: Are the groups and On/Off values easy to scan? Is test feedback sufficiently clear?

screens.title: Status / Feedback
screens.intent: Independent save states, complete failure guidance, and a fixed return/retry footer.
screens.review_question: Are errors easy to distinguish from printer faults? Can you tell which failures retry saves affects?

screens.title: Notification activity
screens.intent: Ownership and capacity above a stable decision list with selected-entry details.
screens.review_question: Are ownership, outcome, reason, and grouped membership easy to understand?

decisions: Compact extremes are secondary; define a below-minimum warning
